items.promptText: What does renting cost across the 7 years?
Owning costs $1,412 a month in loan payments, $296 a month in property tax, and $118 a month in insurance. What is the monthly ownership outlay?
What does that monthly outlay come to across the 7 years?
What does maintenance cost across the 7 years at 1% of the price each year?
What is the total cost of owning across the 7 years, counting the outlay, the maintenance, and the closing costs?
What is the house worth after 7 years at 2.5% appreciation a year?
How much has the house gained in value across the 7 years?
Netting the appreciation against the cost of owning, how much more does owning cost than renting across the 7 years?

This comparison uses the same method as the vehicle analysis earlier in the unit. Name the one term that had to be added for housing, explain why the vehicle case did not need it, and state one important cost this comparison still leaves out.
